reason: 该插件的主要面向用户功能是增强 DSH Web 对话界面：在 edit/write 工具执行后实时可视化行级代码差异，并在回合结尾展示文件级变更汇总，因此可归类为可视化类插件，带有文件变更展示与 UI 展示能力，且实现依赖于本地 git/工具参数差异来源。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web 对话中展示代码改动，支持在工具卡片内逐行高亮显示 edit/write 差异，并在每个回合后给出文件级变更汇总，方便快速查看改动范围。
summaries.en: This plugin enhances the DSH web conversation view by showing edit/write changes as inline line-level diffs and adding per-turn file-level change summaries for quick review of modified files.

capabilities: Displays inline line-level diffs for edit/write tool calls inside DSH conversation cards.
Shows per-turn file-change summary cards with file status and add/remove counts.
Provides a streaming visual reveal mode for diff lines and optional auto-scroll.
Falls back to tool-argument diffs when git diff is unavailable and truncates large diffs for display.

reasons.code: README documents inline diff rendering for edit/write tool cards with streaming line reveal
README documents per-turn file-change summary card and Git-first fallback behavior
package.json declares DSH web client plugin wiring and host/client split entrypoints
